title: Assessment of natural radioactivity in various commercial tiles used for building purposes in Nigeria
author: Joel, Maxwell, et al.

steps.title: Prepare S‑14 reference mixture
steps.instruction: Weigh 20.00 g of IAEA standard Thorium Ore (S‑14) and 100.00 g of SiO₂, mix them thoroughly in a Marinelli beaker and label the beaker as “S‑14”. Record that the original U and Th concentrations in S‑14 are 29 ppm and 610 ppm, respectively, and that after mixing the concentrations become 4.63 ppm U and 97.3 ppm Th.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 20.00 g of IAEA S‑14 sample.
Combine the two powders in a Marinelli beaker and mix thoroughly.
Note original concentrations (U = 29 ppm, Th = 610 ppm) and post‑mixing concentrations (U = 4.63 ppm, Th = 97.3 ppm).

steps.title: Prepare SL‑2 reference mixture
steps.instruction: Weigh 74.18 g of IAEA Lake Sediment (SL‑2) and 100.00 g of SiO₂, mix them thoroughly in a Marinelli beaker and label the beaker as “SL‑2”. This mixture provides the background for standard samples and is used to calculate the specific activity of potassium (K), which is 240 Bq kg⁻¹.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 74.18 g of IAEA SL‑2 sample.
Combine the two powders in a Marinelli beaker and mix thoroughly.
Record that the specific activity of K in SL‑2 is 240 Bq kg⁻¹.
